tools.name: ActiveCampaign
tools.price_note: (re-verified 2026-08-17 in the browser; the figures below are the 'starts at' prices on annual billing, before you pick a contact count) No free plan, trial only. Four tiers: Starter from $15/mo with 1 user, limited segmentation and 5 actions per automation; Plus from $49/mo with 1 user, standard segmentation, unlimited automation actions and landing pages; Pro from $79/mo with 3 users, advanced segmentation, predictive and conditional content and attribution tracking; Enterprise from $145/mo with 5 users, premium segmentation, SSO, custom objects and a dedicated account team. Your email send allowance is a multiple of your contact count — 10x on Starter and Plus, 12x on Pro, 15x on Enterprise. The bill then scales with list size: the per-contact ladder only renders after you select a contact count, which is why we could not re-verify our earlier reading of about $189/mo for Plus at 10,000 contacts on this pass. CRM pipelines, SMS and extra users remain paid add-ons.

tools.name: ADP
tools.price_note: (2026-08-15, read on their own site) ADP shows no public pricing for RUN anywhere on its site, and we checked four places before saying so: /pricing returns a 404, so does /pricing.md, the RUN product page offers only a “Get Pricing” button, and the dedicated package-comparison page lists all four tiers with “Get pricing” under each one and not a single figure. tools.name: AgentNest
tools.price_note: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/agentnest) Four tiers, and the split between them is unusual: the diagnosis is free and you pay only for the repairs. Free: unlimited catalogue scans, a catalogue readiness score, product-level issue reports and the full findings view. Starter $19 a month: 100 successful automated fixes a month, one-click fixes for all eligible issues, product-level recommendations. Growth $49 a month: 1,000 fixes a month, revenue-priority catalogue insights, fix history and progress tracking. Scale $99 a month: 5,000 fixes a month, advanced revenue-priority insights and bulk catalogue fixes. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no tier shows a free trial. The billing unit is a 'successful automated fix' and the listing never defines it — whether one fix is one product, one field on one product, or one alt text on one image is the difference between $19 covering a hundred products and a hundred images, and it is the only variable separating the three paid tiers. Developer Ecommerce Storez, 1255 23rd St NW, Washington DC; the app launched on 6 August 2026 and has no reviews at all.

tools.name: AskNest
tools.price_note: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/asknest-ai-faq-product-bot) Four tiers, priced by AI replies per month, and the cheapest ladder in this category. Free: 50 AI replies a month, replies in one language you select, answers drawn from your FAQs, policy pages and product data, translated storefront widget, product finder and usage tracking. Starter $4.99 a month: 500 replies, automatic shopper-language detection across up to three languages, translated replies, product recommendations and best sellers. Growth $9.99 a month: 1,500 replies and all supported languages. Pro $19.99 a month: 5,000 replies. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and no paid tier shows a free trial — the free plan is the trial. What the listing never says is what happens when you run out: there is no overage rate anywhere on the page, so whether reply 501 costs money or simply does not happen is not published. 'Any language' is also not on offer; customer-facing replies and widget labels cover English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Brazilian Portuguese — seven. Developer Ecommerce Storez, 1255 23rd St NW, Washington DC; the app launched 8 May 2026 and has exactly one App Store review.

tools.name: Castmagic
tools.price_note: (read 2026-08-19 on castmagic.io/pricing) Three published tiers plus an enterprise band, and the page opens on annual billing with a 'Save 30%' label, so every headline number is the annual rate. Hobby: $19 a month billed annually, $239 a year, 30 transcribed hours, up to 3 Spaces, 50GB storage, 3 seats, no API access, no onboarding call. Starter: $48 a month billed annually, $579 a year, 100 transcribed hours, 10 Spaces, 250GB, 5 seats, API access, onboarding call. Team: $139 a month billed annually, $1,669 a year, 400 transcribed hours, 25 Spaces, 1TB, unlimited seats with 5 included and extras at $159 a year or $19 a month each, priority support. Business & Scale: from $699 a month and $999 a month, by demo, for custom volume, seats, storage, SLA and dedicated support. Unlimited AI outputs, re-generations, media clipping and audiograms are on all three published tiers, as are 60+ transcription languages, a 10GB maximum file size and the Zoom, Google Drive, Zapier, RSS and YouTube/TikTok/Instagram imports. The monthly-billing prices are behind a toggle that the page does not put in its source, so the only thing we can state about them is what the page states: annual saves 30%. And the hours need care — the table calls them 'transcribed hours (library total)' and the FAQ calls them 'a growing library of transcribed hours that you build up over time', which never actually says whether the allowance renews each month or is a running ceiling. Extra hours can be bought at any time on every tier.

tools.name: ChatGPT AI Product Description
tools.price_note: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/automated-description-writing) Four tiers, priced in credits per month. Free Trial: 100 credits a month. Basic $19 a month or $190 a year (save 17%): 2,000 credits, product descriptions, titles and meta descriptions, formatted descriptions, automatic descriptions on import. Standard $49 a month or $399 a year (save 32%): 11,000 credits, same feature list. Pro $249 a month or $1,990 a year (save 33%): 110,000 credits, same list plus priority video-call support. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Every paid tier carries the same strapline — 'Only $1 per 100 Descriptions' — and it only holds at the bottom of the ladder: $19 for 2,000 credits is 95 cents per hundred, $49 for 11,000 is 45 cents, $249 for 110,000 is 23 cents. So the $1 is a ceiling on the cheapest plan rather than a rate, and it assumes one credit equals one description, which the listing never states. That is the central gap in this pricing: nowhere does the page say what a title, a meta description or an alt text costs in credits, or what the 'Pro Features' that use product images, metadata and web search cost extra. Developer Profitonium, Adugodi, Bangalore; the app launched 12 March 2021, holds Shopify's 'Built for Shopify' badge and carries a 4.9 average over 466 App Store reviews.
